title: Orders stop reaching fulfillment
brief: At 10:05 UTC the oldest order awaiting fulfillment is five minutes old. Orders continue arriving in a standard SQS queue with one Lambda consumer.
question: Which signal distinguishes a producer spike from a stalled consumer, and how would you show that orders are flowing again?

evidence.observation: A maintenance window starts. Producers continue sending around 60 messages per minute.
ApproximateNumberOfMessagesVisible is 299 and ApproximateAgeOfOldestMessage is 299 seconds. The worker recorded zero successful orders in the last five minutes.
The mapping from the orders queue to the fulfillment worker reports State=Disabled. Maintenance finished at 10:02 UTC.

workedResponse.diagnosis: The sender rate is steady. The only consumer stopped polling when its event source mapping was disabled and never resumed after maintenance.
workedResponse.mitigation: Verify maintenance is complete and that the worker can process queued orders idempotently, then re-enable the existing mapping.
workedResponse.recovery: Watch successful fulfillments resume, oldest-message age and visible depth return to baseline, and a newly submitted order complete.
